title: Instructions for approved LBI TBI Projects under ASPIRE Scheme
text: No.6!77/2016-KVI-I Government of India Ministry of Micro, Small and-Medium Enterprises (KVI-I Section) Udyog Ehawan, New Delhi-1100ll Dated the 16thAugust, 2017 CIRCULAR Subject: Instructions for approved LBI/TBI Projects under ASPIRE Scheme - regarding. +++++++ Secretary (MSME) has laid emphasis on the following for strict compliance of all approved LBI & TBI projects during the meetings of SSCof ASPIRE:- i. All the approved LBIs should adhere to timelines of the projects; n. Finalize trades as per capacities of the centres; iii. Follow the strict purchase conditions for machineries as per GFR or State Financial Regulations to avoid any irregularities; iv. Incubation Centres must ensure that applicants are screened properly before being taken on-board to avoid any non-serious candidates joining the incubation leading to lesser conversion; v. Minimum fees may be charged by all the LBIs so that the incubation does not happen free of cost and the centres also become self- sustainable over a period of time; VI. Regular uploading of data and progress/inspection report on the web- portal (www.aspiremsme.gov.in) by individual LBIs/TBIs; , 1U) Under Secretary to the Govt. of India Tel No. 011-23062573 Email: sahu.jk@nic.in To, Heads of All LEl's/TEl's under ASPIRE t\.l I c, -- 1 of 1 --
